controls.action: Restore after fresh process with no cache

controls.action: Resume after a documented failed approach

controls.action: Change tested code SHA or a receipt hash

controls.action: Exceed budget with mandatory state or fixed MCP schemas

controls.action: Read assumptions, supporting evidence and counter-evidence from pack
